```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)

whale_shark_raw <- read_tsv("data/whale_shark/occurrence.txt", show_col_types = FALSE)
beluga_raw <- read_tsv("data/beluga/occurrence.txt", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Prepare all 2,391 Whale Shark tracking & sighting points (Coral Sea)
whale_shark_points <- whale_shark_raw |>
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    date = as.Date(eventDate),
    shark_name = str_remove(
      coalesce(occurrenceRemarks, "Coral Sea Sighting"),
      "^Animal name:\\s*"
    ),
    track_id = coalesce(as.character(organismID), "Unmarked"),
    common_name = paste0("Whale Shark (", shark_name, ")")
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(date), !is.na(scientificName)) |>
  arrange(track_id, eventDate, id) |>
  mutate(
    first_seen = min(date),
    last_seen = max(date),
    total_span_days = as.numeric(last_seen - first_seen),
    days_elapsed = as.numeric(date - first_seen),
    spotting_num = row_number(),
    total_spottings = n(),
    .by = c(scientificName, track_id, shark_name)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    group = "Whale Shark Trackings (Coral Sea)",
    label = paste0(common_name, " — ID: ", track_id, " (", scientificName, ")")
  )

# Prepare Beluga Whale acoustic detection points (Western Beaufort Sea)
beluga_points <- beluga_raw |>
  filter(scientificName == "Delphinapterus leucas") |>
  mutate(
    id = as.character(id),
    date = as.Date(eventDate),
    track_id = coalesce(as.character(organismID), "Beaufort_Mooring"),
    common_name = paste0("Beluga Whale (", track_id, ")")
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(date), !is.na(scientificName)) |>
  arrange(track_id, eventDate, id) |>
  mutate(
    first_seen = min(date),
    last_seen = max(date),
    total_span_days = as.numeric(last_seen - first_seen),
    days_elapsed = as.numeric(date - first_seen),
    spotting_num = row_number(),
    total_spottings = n(),
    .by = c(scientificName, track_id)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    group = "Beluga Whale Detections (Beaufort Sea)",
    label = paste0(common_name, " (", scientificName, ")")
  )

all_occurrences <- bind_rows(
  whale_shark_points |>
    select(
      id, common_name, scientificName, label, group, date, first_seen, last_seen,
      days_elapsed, total_span_days, spotting_num, total_spottings,
      decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude
    ),
  beluga_points |>
    select(
      id, common_name, scientificName, label, group, date, first_seen, last_seen,
      days_elapsed, total_span_days, spotting_num, total_spottings,
      decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude
    )
) |>
  mutate(
    hover_text = paste0(
      "<b>Common Name: ", common_name, "</b><br>",
      "Scientific Name: <i>", scientificName, "</i><br>",
      "Organism / ID: ", label, "<br>",
      "Group: ", group, "<br>",
      "Event Date: ", date, "<br>",
      "Spotting / Tracking #: ", spotting_num, " of ", total_spottings, "<br>",
      "Days Elapsed: ", days_elapsed, " days (Total Span: ", total_span_days, " days)<br>",
      "Coordinates: (", round(decimalLatitude, 3), ", ", round(decimalLongitude, 3), ")"
    )
  )

shared_occurrences <- SharedData$new(all_occurrences)
```

## Individual Spottings and Trackings of Whale Sharks and Beluga Whales

Use the interactive filters below, the **Timeframe View** dropdown at the top-left of the chart, or the bottom range slider to pinpoint specific timeframes, spotting counts, or individual organisms across all **`r scales::comma(nrow(all_occurrences))` points**.

<div class="filter-row">
<div>
```{r}
filter_slider(
  "span_filter",
  "1. Pinpoint Observation Span (Days Elapsed):",
  shared_occurrences,
  ~days_elapsed,
  step = 10
)
```
</div>
<div>
```{r}
filter_slider(
  "spotting_filter",
  "2. Pinpoint Spotting / Tracking Count:",
  shared_occurrences,
  ~spotting_num,
  step = 5
)
```
</div>
<div>
```{r}
filter_select(
  "name_filter",
  "3. Filter by Common Name / Individual:",
  shared_occurrences,
  ~common_name
)
```
</div>
</div>

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = shared_occurrences,
  x = ~days_elapsed,
  y = ~spotting_num,
  color = ~group,
  colors = c(
    "Beluga Whale Detections (Beaufort Sea)" = "#38bdf8",
    "Whale Shark Trackings (Coral Sea)" = "#0f766e"
  ),
  text = ~hover_text,
  hoverinfo = "text",
  type = "scattergl",
  mode = "markers",
  width = "100%",
  height = 680,
  marker = list(size = 6, opacity = 0.65)
) |>
  layout(
    autosize = TRUE,
    margin = list(t = 125, r = 25, b = 65, l = 65),
    title = list(
      text = "Whale Shark vs. Beluga Whale Spottings & Trackings Over Observation Date Span",
      x = 0.5,
      xanchor = "center",
      y = 0.98,
      yanchor = "top"
    ),
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Observation Date Span Elapsed (Days Since First Sighting)",
      rangemode = "nonnegative",
      minallowed = 0,
      range = c(0, 4050),
      tick0 = 0,
      rangeslider = list(visible = TRUE, thickness = 0.08, range = c(0, 4050))
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Cumulative Spotting / Tracking Count",
      rangemode = "nonnegative",
      minallowed = 0,
      range = c(0, 1300),
      tick0 = 0
    ),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 1, xanchor = "right", y = 1.11, yanchor = "bottom"),
    updatemenus = list(
      list(
        type = "dropdown",
        x = 0,
        xanchor = "left",
        y = 1.02,
        yanchor = "bottom",
        buttons = list(
          list(
            label = "View: All Timeframes (0–4,006 Days)",
            method = "relayout",
            args = list(list(
              "xaxis.type" = "linear",
              "xaxis.range" = c(0, 4050),
              "yaxis.range" = c(0, 1300)
            ))
          ),
          list(
            label = "View: Spread Evenly (Log Scale X-Axis)",
            method = "relayout",
            args = list(list(
              "xaxis.type" = "log",
              "xaxis.autorange" = TRUE,
              "yaxis.range" = c(0, 1300)
            ))
          ),
          list(
            label = "Zoom: 0–400 Days (Beluga & Tagged Whale Shark Overlap)",
            method = "relayout",
            args = list(list(
              "xaxis.type" = "linear",
              "xaxis.range" = c(0, 405),
              "yaxis.range" = c(0, 1300)
            ))
          ),
          list(
            label = "Zoom: Tagged Whale Sharks Detail (0–400 Days, 1–450 Spottings)",
            method = "relayout",
            args = list(list(
              "xaxis.type" = "linear",
              "xaxis.range" = c(0, 405),
              "yaxis.range" = c(0, 450)
            ))
          ),
          list(
            label = "Zoom: Multi-Year Whale Sharks (300–4,010 Days)",
            method = "relayout",
            args = list(list(
              "xaxis.type" = "linear",
              "xaxis.range" = c(300, 4010),
              "yaxis.range" = c(0, 300)
            ))
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) |>
  config(responsive = TRUE)
```
